features.title: Why EasyLaces?
features.subtitle: Designed for comfort, built to last
features.ecoDesc: Made from recyclable, biodegradable PLA+ material — safe for everyday use.
features.craftedDesc: Each clip is individually crafted and hand-finished for consistent quality and a perfect fit.
features.durableDesc: Strong enough for daily wear, yet light and comfortable on any shoe.
features.heatDesc: Designed for everyday use. Can handle temperatures up to ~60 °C. Avoid leaving in direct sun or hot environments for long periods.
features.fitDesc: Designed for laces 5–6 mm wide and up to 2 mm thick — fits most sneakers and sports shoes.
features.fitTip: Tip: Some lace tips may be slightly thicker. Gently press with pliers for a smooth fit through the clip.

modal.title: Shipping & Usage Guide
modal.shippingBullet2: €4.00 flat fee for all orders. Free with the 4x bundle.
modal.shippingBullet4: 🏬 Pickup by arrangement: available at Kings Avenue Mall, Paphos. Choose 'Pickup' at checkout and we'll confirm a time on WhatsApp.
modal.step1Desc: Thread your laces through the clip following the arrows.
modal.step2Desc: Once threaded, the clip holds your laces in place — no knots needed.
modal.fitDesc: Works with laces 5–6 mm wide and up to 2 mm thick. If needed, gently flatten the plastic tip with pliers for an easier fit.
